title: Unions of flush prismatic parts stay analytic
summary: Posts, tabs and bosses unioned into a body with shared top and bottom faces no longer double or drop the caps over their overlap; operand order no longer changes the result.
details: A small coplanar face lying inside a larger one was judged coincident from one side only, so `post ∪ ring` kept both copies of the overlap while `ring ∪ post` was exact; the larger face now wins. Planar faces are no longer cut by full-width chords from faces that merely end flush on them, which scrambled classification once two such chords crossed (twelve posts into a ring lost 9% of their volume). A line crossing a notched face in several spans now cuts the span it was recorded on rather than always the first. The rana-60 stator goes from 105k triangles of mesh fallback to 11.7k analytic triangles at +0.06% of its reference volume, in under half the time.
